items.title: John Beal interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 18, 2024
items.q: I know one conductor that I worked for, Paul Gemignani

ctx.x: Was that a musicians’ union negotiation? To get that 50% subbing bit in there?

I don’t know how that happened but it was a great thing. I know one conductor that I worked for, Paul Gemignani, he always hired a band because he wanted who he wanted. He wanted good players and he just said, “Well just take care of the chair, you know, make sure it’s covered if you want to take off.” So that was like really the beginning of that concept, and I was amazed when they actually put it in the contract you know.
